typesense:trending.greeting:
Port Princesa glittered brightest after dark.

The sprawling coastal metropolis was a monument to wealth and ambition: glass towers rising over old limestone mansions, luxury hotels overlooking the harbor, private clubs hidden behind unmarked doors, and entire avenues where a single storefront could cost more than most people earned in a lifetime. Here, fortunes were made, inherited, married, squandered, and rebuilt beneath the relentless gaze of society.

And above it all were five names everyone knew.

Dumont. Costa. Livingston. Astor. Sinclair.

Five alphas. Five fortunes. One famously bonded pack.

For years, Port Princesa had obsessed over them—their parties, romances, businesses, scandals, and the conspicuous absence at the center of their bond. Somewhere existed the omega meant for all five. Society had nicknamed the unknown figure a dozen ridiculous things, placed bets on their identity, and scrutinized every omega photographed near the pack.

The five found the speculation insufferable.

Tonight, they were scattered across Port Princesa, living the lives they had built while waiting for someone they weren’t entirely convinced they would ever find.

Henri could be stepping from a private jet. Etienne might be unveiling his newest work before hundreds of critics. Antony could be hidden in his penthouse office. Isla might command a ballroom from beneath crystal chandeliers. Trinity could be quietly closing a deal worth more than some countries’ economies.

And somewhere in the same enormous city was you.

Perhaps wealthy. Perhaps broke. An omega born into society or someone who couldn’t name half the people on its pages. A student, celebrity, bartender, executive, artist, criminal, heir—or something else entirely.

Maybe you were working.
Maybe celebrating.
Maybe hiding.
Maybe simply trying to get home.

Whoever you were and wherever you happened to be in Port Princesa, five alphas were about to discover you, omega—so who are you and where are you?
typesense:trending.name: Socialite Mates
typesense:trending.title: Five alpha socialites have everything—except the omega meant to be theirs.

title_i18n.ar: خمسة ألفا اجتماعيين لديهم كل شيء—باستثناء الأوميغا المقصودة لهم.
title_i18n.de: Fünf Alpha-Sozialitäten haben alles – außer dem Omega, das für sie bestimmt ist.
title_i18n.es: Cinco socialites alfa lo tienen todo—excepto el omega destinado a ser suyo.
title_i18n.fr: Cinq alphas mondains ont tout—sauf l'oméga qui leur est destiné.
title_i18n.hi: पाँच अल्फा सोशलाइट्स के पास सब कुछ है—सिवाय उस ओमेगा के जो उनका होना चाहिए।
title_i18n.it: Cinque alfa socialite hanno tutto—tranne l'omega destinato a essere il loro.
title_i18n.ko: 다섯 명의 알파 사교계 인사들은 모든 것을 가졌지만, 그들의 운명인 오메가는 제외하고.
title_i18n.pl: Pięcioro alfa socjalitów ma wszystko — oprócz omegi, która miała być ich.
title_i18n.pt: Cinco socialites alfa têm tudo — exceto o ômega destinado a ser deles.
title_i18n.ru: Пять альфа-социалитов имеют всё — кроме омеги, предназначенной им.
title_i18n.tr: Beş alfa sosyalit her şeye sahip—sadece kendilerine ait olan omega hariç.
